title: Orange5 ToolMesh Tool-Card v0
description: Tool-Card — a capability indicator that lives inside one of the eleven ToolMesh capability labs (image, video, audio, design, coding, automation, analytics, public-agent, observability, security, releaseops). OrangeLLM consults tool-cards during planning to discover what the mesh CAN do and at what cost/latency before requesting operator approval. Tool-cards are NOT permission-to-execute and are NOT execution descriptors — actual execution is gated by Hermes leases issued against default_lease_template. Tool-cards are JSON-schema'd, hot-reloadable, and side-effect-free. card_id is the stable handle the planner cites; the (lab, card_id) pair is unique within the mesh. last_verified_at is the wall-clock timestamp of the most recent successful health/capability probe; the planner downgrades or skips cards whose verification has gone stale per lab policy.

lab.description: Which of the eleven ToolMesh capability labs owns this card. Closed enum; new labs require a schema bump.

card_id.description: Stable handle for this card within the mesh. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, dots; starts with a letter, ends with letter-or-digit. (lab, card_id) is the unique key the planner cites.

capability.description: Dotted capability id this card advertises (e.g. 'image.generate', 'coding.refactor.python', 'releaseops.deploy.canary'). The Least-action Router matches this against task requirements during planning.

cost_class.description: Coarse cost bucket for planner-time triage. 'free' = no marginal cost; 'byo-key' = operator must supply credentials and bears upstream billing; 'metered' = mesh charges per invocation against a budget. Real cost ceilings live in the lease, not here.

latency_class.description: Coarse latency bucket. 'sub-second' = interactive; 'seconds' = synchronous tool-call within a turn; 'minutes' = long-running, expect lease + async handoff. Real timeouts live in the lease, not here.

inputs.description: JSON Schema fragment describing the input contract the planner will populate. Validated as a JSON-Schema object; deep per-field semantics are the tool-runner's responsibility.

outputs.description: JSON Schema fragment describing what a successful invocation returns. Lets the planner reason about downstream chaining without executing the tool.

default_lease_template.description: Default Hermes lease template the planner cites when requesting execution rights. The lease — not this card — is the authoritative permission-to-execute. Operator review can override any field at lease-issue time.

ttl_seconds.description: Lease lifetime in seconds. Hermes refuses leases above lab-policy ceiling.

max_invocations.description: Hard cap on tool calls this lease authorizes before re-approval.

scopes.description: Capability scopes the lease grants (e.g. 'fs.read:/tmp', 'net.egress:api.example.com', 'gpu.use'). Least-privilege; planner is encouraged to narrow these at request time.

human_approval_required.description: If true, Hermes will refuse to auto-issue this lease and require explicit operator approval per invocation. Defaults to false; high-risk cards set this true.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Soft cap on invocations per minute under one lease. Optional; absence means lab default.

egress_allowlist.description: Optional host allowlist for network egress under this lease. Hosts only (no schemes); wildcards permitted as leading '*.'.

risk_class.description: Blast-radius bucket the planner and operator see at approval time. 'read-only' = no side effects; 'sandboxed' = effects bounded to mesh-owned scratch space; 'mutating' = writes to operator-owned state; 'external-side-effect' = irreversible action on the world (deploy, post, pay, email). High classes typically pair with human_approval_required=true in the lease template.

last_verified_at.description: Wall-clock timestamp (RFC 3339, UTC) of the most recent successful health/capability probe by the lab's verifier. Hot-reload updates this; stale cards are demoted or skipped by the planner per lab policy.

vendor.description: Optional human-facing vendor or upstream provider id (e.g. 'openai', 'anthropic', 'self-hosted'). Not authoritative; for surfacing in approval dialogs.

version.description: Optional semver for the underlying tool/integration. Distinct from card schema version.

summary.description: Optional one-line human-facing description shown in planner traces and approval dialogs.

tags.description: Optional human-facing tags for discovery / filtering. Not part of routing logic.

deprecated.description: If true, planner avoids selecting this card except when explicitly named. Used during lab migrations.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes from the lab maintainer. Not consumed by the planner.
